capabilities: Open a random note from the sidebar dice icon or a command
Draw one of 20 embedded pixel cats with each pull
Exclude folders or restrict draws to daily notes
Avoid drawing the same note consecutively
Append each drawn note to a configurable check-in log file
extras: README and manifest are written in Chinese; installation is manual (copy main.js, manifest.json, styles.css into the plugins folder).
problem: Obsidian's built-in random note has no filtering, no repeat avoidance, and no gamified or logged draw experience.
summary: Gacha-style random note opener that opens a random vault note via a sidebar dice icon or command, drawing a pixel cat and logging each pull.
